source: Design flow arrows of the 2026-10-19 Design spec (Figma file dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ). One-time import 2026-10-21 of the arrow inventory the spec agent recorded with node IDs (user approved); later spec sets build this list in the analysis (Coverage pass 1).

arrows.edge: Launcher AI Mini Drama banner → Mini Drama landing
arrows.expected: The AI Mini Drama launcher banner opens the Mini Drama entry page.

arrows.edge: Launcher AI Mini Drama shortcut → Mini Drama landing
arrows.expected: Activating the AI Mini Drama launcher shortcut opens the Mini Drama landing page.

arrows.edge: Create Your Drama → empty custom idea input with keyboard
arrows.expected: Create Your Drama opens an empty custom-idea input with the keyboard displayed.

arrows.edge: Displayed inspiration → populated unsent idea
arrows.expected: Selecting a displayed inspiration populates the empty drama idea input.

arrows.edge: Idea Send → Format options
arrows.expected: Before video creation the chat asks for video format, including language and captions.

arrows.edge: Custom Format Generate → outline loading
arrows.expected: Generate on the custom-story Format card starts outline drafting.

arrows.edge: Template Format Generate → outline loading
arrows.expected: Generate on the template-story Format card starts outline drafting.

arrows.edge: Outline character slot → Choose Character
arrows.expected: Activating a named chat cast slot opens Choose Character for that slot.

arrows.edge: Completed picker checkmark → Characters Result
arrows.expected: Character results show each character name with its corresponding photo.

arrows.edge: Custom storyboard Generate → storyboard loading
arrows.expected: Generate on the custom-story storyboard offer starts storyboard loading.

arrows.edge: Template storyboard Generate → storyboard loading
arrows.expected: Generate on the template-story storyboard offer starts storyboard loading.

arrows.edge: Custom preview-video Generate → video loading
arrows.expected: Starting video creation displays an in-progress video state in the chat; no fixed Generating Video literal is required.

arrows.edge: Template preview-video Generate → video loading
arrows.expected: Starting video creation displays an in-progress video state in the chat; no fixed Generating Video literal is required.

arrows.edge: Custom full-video offer Generate → video loading
arrows.expected: Starting video creation displays an in-progress video state in the chat; no fixed Generating Video literal is required.

arrows.edge: Custom outline drafting → cast-building loading
arrows.expected: Successful custom outline drafting advances to cast-building loading.

arrows.edge: Custom cast-building loading → outline with unset character slots
arrows.expected: Successful custom cast-building presents the outline with unset character slots awaiting selection.

arrows.edge: Template full-video offer Generate → video loading
arrows.expected: Starting video creation displays an in-progress video state in the chat; no fixed Generating Video literal is required.

arrows.edge: Template outline drafting → cast-building loading
arrows.expected: Successful template outline drafting advances to cast-building loading.

arrows.edge: Template cast-building loading → completed Characters Result
arrows.expected: Character results show each character name with its corresponding photo.

arrows.edge: Custom full-video loading → completed video and next-episode offer
arrows.expected: The completed custom drama offers Create Next Episode.

arrows.edge: Unassigned picker → assigned cast portraits
arrows.expected: Selecting a library character applies that look to the currently selected cast slot.

arrows.edge: Custom storyboard loading → preview and model/length offer
arrows.expected: Before video generation, the completed storyboard exposes the Storyboard Preview surface, separately from its generated scene cards.

arrows.edge: Template storyboard loading → preview and model/length offer
arrows.expected: Before video generation, the completed storyboard exposes the Storyboard Preview surface, separately from its generated scene cards.

arrows.edge: Custom preview-video loading → completed preview/full-video offer
arrows.expected: Successful custom preview-video generation presents its playable preview and full-video offer.

arrows.edge: Template full-video loading → completed video and Edit
arrows.expected: Successful template full-video generation presents the completed video and Edit action.

arrows.edge: Template preview-video loading → completed preview/full-video offer
arrows.expected: Successful template preview-video generation presents its playable preview and full-video offer.

arrows.edge: Named chat cast slot → picker targeting that character
arrows.expected: Activating a named chat cast slot opens Choose Character for that slot.

arrows.edge: Finish your characters X → picker (right to left)
arrows.expected: X on Finish your characters returns to the picker without applying generated replacements.

arrows.edge: Expanded character text collapse → form (right to left)
arrows.expected: The expanded custom-character text editor collapse control returns to the character form.

arrows.edge: Missing-character loading → completed portraits and Confirm
arrows.expected: Successful missing-character generation replaces loading with the generated portraits and Confirm.

arrows.edge: Custom character loading → completed views and Save
arrows.expected: Successful custom-character generation replaces the loading state with the generated views and Save to library.

arrows.edge: Library look thumbnail → selected look and cast portrait
arrows.expected: Selecting a library character applies that look to the currently selected cast slot.

arrows.edge: Picker checkmark with unset slots → Finish your characters
arrows.expected: The incomplete-character prompt identifies the characters that remain unset and reports their count accurately.

arrows.edge: Picker X → leave warning → chat, routed above screens
arrows.expected: Closing the unfinished character picker presents a warning that leaving will lose the current picks, with Leave and Keep choosing actions. Leave exits the unfinished character picker without saving its unsaved picks.

arrows.edge: Picker warning Keep choosing preserves unsaved picks
arrows.expected: Keep choosing dismisses the unfinished-picker warning and retains the current unsaved picks.

arrows.edge: Generate all missing → missing-character loading
arrows.expected: Generate all on Finish your characters starts loading for the unset characters.

arrows.edge: Completed missing-character Confirm → Characters Result
arrows.expected: Confirm after missing-character generation returns to chat with the completed cast.

arrows.edge: Insufficient missing-character Generate → credit top-up
arrows.expected: Attempting missing-character generation with insufficient credits opens the credit panel.

arrows.edge: Annotation identifying long-press character description scrolling range
arrows.expected: Long custom-character description text can be scrolled within its annotated text area.

arrows.edge: Create my character → custom-character form
arrows.expected: Create my character opens the custom-character form for the currently selected cast slot.

arrows.edge: AI Suggestion → populated description and attributes
arrows.expected: AI Suggestion fills the custom-character description and accompanying attributes.

arrows.edge: Character description tap/expand → text editor
arrows.expected: The custom-character description expansion control opens its expanded text editor.

arrows.edge: Age field → numeric input
arrows.expected: Editing character age opens numeric input for the age field.

arrows.edge: Reference → Add Media
arrows.expected: Reference opens Add Media for choosing a reference photo.

arrows.edge: Character text Done → form, returning left
arrows.expected: Done returns from the expanded custom-character text editor to the character form.

arrows.edge: Selected photo → Crop
arrows.expected: Choosing a reference photo opens Crop with that photo.

arrows.edge: Custom Generate with reference → character loading
arrows.expected: Generate on the valid custom-character form starts character loading for the submitted description and reference.

arrows.edge: Completed Save to library → selected new Mine character
arrows.expected: Save to library stores the completed custom character and applies it to the selected cast slot.

arrows.edge: Thumbnail magnify → enlarged character preview
arrows.expected: The character thumbnail preview control opens an enlarged character preview.

arrows.edge: Completed custom X → unselected picker, routed above screens
arrows.expected: X after completed custom-character generation does not apply the generated character to the cast slot.

arrows.edge: Filter checkmark → filtered picker
arrows.expected: The Filter checkmark returns to the character picker with the selected criteria applied.

arrows.edge: Default Filter → chosen gender/ethnicity/age criteria
arrows.expected: Selecting gender, ethnicity and age criteria updates the Filter panel selections before applying them.

arrows.edge: Filter Clear → default filter values (right to left)
arrows.expected: Clear resets selected character filter criteria to their default state.

arrows.edge: Picker Filter icon → Filter panel
arrows.expected: The Choose Character filter icon opens the Filter panel.

arrows.edge: Different cast slot → changed target and reset filters
arrows.expected: Choosing a different cast slot updates the target name and resets character filters to default.

arrows.edge: Annotation identifying long-press scene description scrolling range
arrows.expected: Long scene-description text can be scrolled within its annotated text area.

arrows.edge: Storyboard scene card → illustration details
arrows.expected: Activating a storyboard scene card opens scene details.

arrows.edge: Scene 1 right arrow → Scene 2 detail
arrows.expected: The scene-detail right arrow opens the next scene.

arrows.edge: Storyboard Preview play → preview player
arrows.expected: The Storyboard Preview play control opens the preview player.

arrows.edge: Second storyboard scene card → illustration details
arrows.expected: Activating a storyboard scene card opens scene details.

arrows.edge: Full-video settings Generate → video loading
arrows.expected: Starting video creation displays an in-progress video state in the chat; no fixed Generating Video literal is required.

arrows.edge: Full-video loading → completed video and next-episode offer
arrows.expected: The completed custom drama offers Create Next Episode.

arrows.edge: Completed video play → scene-video detail/player
arrows.expected: Activating the completed chat video play control opens the scene-video player.

arrows.edge: Repeated-failure Edit → expanded scene description
arrows.expected: Edit on a failed scene-video opens its description editor.

arrows.edge: Regenerate scene quote → same scene loading
arrows.expected: Submitting the scene-video regeneration request starts clip generation.

arrows.edge: Failed video editor collapse → regeneration quote
arrows.expected: Collapsing the failed scene-video description editor returns to its regeneration offer.

arrows.edge: Failed video editor Done → regeneration quote
arrows.expected: Done in the failed scene-video editor returns to its regeneration offer.

arrows.edge: Recent Task state → Rename/Delete menu
arrows.expected: A Recent Task action menu exposes Rename and Delete.

arrows.edge: Outline-stage Recent Task → restored outline chat
arrows.expected: Reopening a saved task shows the latest outline state rather than the complete session chat history.

arrows.edge: Storyboard-stage Recent Task → restored storyboard chat
arrows.expected: Reopening a saved storyboard-stage task restores its latest saved storyboard information.

arrows.edge: Insufficient storyboard Buy Credits → top-up
arrows.expected: When credits are insufficient for a generation or regeneration offer, its credit action opens the top-up panel.

arrows.edge: Keyboard-visible long idea → collapsed idea after keyboard dismissal
arrows.expected: Dismissing the keyboard collapses a long idea input to at most three displayed lines.

arrows.edge: Insufficient full-video Buy Credits → top-up
arrows.expected: When credits are insufficient for a generation or regeneration offer, its credit action opens the top-up panel.

arrows.edge: Crop drag/pinch → adjusted reference framing
arrows.expected: Dragging the reference photo in Crop adjusts how it fits the frame.

arrows.edge: Crop pinch changes reference framing
arrows.expected: Pinching the reference photo in Crop adjusts how it fits the frame.

arrows.edge: Crop checkmark → form with reference
arrows.expected: The Crop checkmark returns to Create my character with the selected cropped reference.

arrows.edge: Failed storyboard image card → failed scene details
arrows.expected: Opening a failed storyboard scene exposes its failed image and Edit route in scene details.

arrows.edge: Failed storyboard editor Done → regeneration offer
arrows.expected: Done from the failed-scene description editor opens the regeneration offer with the edited text.

arrows.edge: Failed storyboard editor collapse → regeneration offer
arrows.expected: Collapsing the failed-scene description editor returns to the regeneration offer.

arrows.edge: Regenerate Image → same scene loading
arrows.expected: Regenerate Image starts replacement generation for the failed storyboard scene.

arrows.edge: Missing-character failure Got it → picker with partial results
arrows.expected: Got it dismisses the character-image failure message and returns to the character picker.

arrows.edge: Custom-character failure Got it → retained custom form
arrows.expected: Got it on a custom-character server failure returns to the character form with the reference and description retained.

arrows.edge: Failed scene Retry → same scene loading
arrows.expected: Retry on a failed scene video starts generation for that scene.

arrows.edge: Scene retry loading → repeated-failure Edit state
arrows.expected: A repeatedly failed scene-video request exposes Edit with the retry-failure explanation.

arrows.edge: Scene-video detail Back during regeneration → chat retains existing video and shows Updating 1 scene / video will refresh when done
arrows.expected: Returning from a generating scene video to chat retains the existing video and shows the scene-update status.

arrows.edge: Chat updating-scene state → refreshed completed video, download and Create Next Episode
arrows.expected: When scene-video regeneration finishes, chat replaces the prior video with the refreshed completed video.

arrows.edge: Captions could not be added: Try again → Adding captions state; video and next-episode offer remain visible
arrows.expected: Try again below a caption-failed video changes the status to Adding captions while retaining the video and next-episode offer.

arrows.edge: Adding captions → completed captioned video with download and next-episode offer
arrows.expected: Successful caption retry replaces Adding captions with the captioned video and removes the failure message.

arrows.edge: Storyboard Error: failed scene detail (Location and scene failed) · 「Edit」 on the error card → description editor (編輯)
arrows.expected: 「Edit」 on the failed scene's 「Couldn't create image」 card opens the description editor: the full description is editable with the keyboard up, a x/1000 counter, a trash icon and 「Done」.

arrows.edge: Storyboard Error: failed scene detail · ⓘ on the 「Couldn't create image」 card → 4xx dialog 「Couldn't generate this image」
arrows.expected: ⓘ on a 4xx 「Couldn't create image」 card opens the dialog 「Couldn't generate this image」 / 「Your credits have been refunded. This description may not meet our terms of service, … Edit it below and try again.」 with a terms-of-service link and 「Got it」; 5xx cards have no ⓘ.

arrows.edge: Storyboard Error: scene image regenerating (生成, skeletons in scene detail) → regenerated scene detail
arrows.expected: When the regeneration finishes, the skeletons in the scene detail are replaced by the new Location and scene images side by side; the 「Couldn't create image」 card and 「Edit」 are gone and the title and full script stay.

arrows.edge: 1016_Chat navigation: Chat (any stage) · Back (←, top left) → leave dialog
arrows.expected: Back in the chat opens the leave dialog (Leave anyway / Stay) when leaving would lose something; per PM 10/21 (REQ-029) that is 「Leave this chat?」/「Your story outline isn't ready yet, so this chat won't be saved.」 while the outline generates and 「Stop and lose your credits?」 during a short job; a saved chat or a generating video leaves with no dialog.

arrows.edge: 1016_Chat navigation: Chat (any stage) · credit pill (◆400) → leave dialog
arrows.expected: The credit pill in the chat opens the same leave dialog as Back (Leave anyway / Stay), with the PM 10/21 stage rules (REQ-029).

arrows.edge: 1016_Chat navigation: Chat (any stage) · New chat (top right) → leave dialog
arrows.expected: New chat in the chat opens the same leave dialog as Back (Leave anyway / Stay), with the PM 10/21 stage rules (REQ-029).

arrows.edge: 1016_Chat navigation: Chat (any stage) · History (top right) → leave dialog
arrows.expected: History in the chat opens the same leave dialog as Back (Leave anyway / Stay), with the PM 10/21 stage rules (REQ-029).

arrows.edge: 1016_Chat navigation: leave dialog 「Leave anyway」 (opened by History) → ④ Recent Task
arrows.expected: 「Leave anyway」 in a dialog opened by History leaves the chat and opens Recent Task (History list).

arrows.edge: 1016_Chat navigation: leave dialog 「Leave anyway」 (opened by New chat) → ② new empty chat
arrows.expected: 「Leave anyway」 in a dialog opened by New chat leaves the chat and opens a new empty chat (「Hi, I'm your AI Drama Assistant」, 「Surprise me」, idea suggestions, empty composer).

arrows.edge: 1016_Chat navigation: leave dialog 「Leave anyway」 (opened by the credit pill) → ③ My Credits
arrows.expected: 「Leave anyway」 in a dialog opened by the credit pill leaves the chat and opens My Credits.

arrows.edge: 1016_Chat navigation: leave dialog 「Leave anyway」 (opened by Back) → ① AI Mini Drama home page
arrows.expected: 「Leave anyway」 in a dialog opened by Back leaves the chat and opens the AI Mini Drama home page (「Hi, I'm your AI Drama Assistant」, 「Create Your Drama」, 「Start from a template」).

arrows.edge: 1016_Chat navigation: leave dialog 「Stay」 → Chat (same stage)
arrows.expected: 「Stay」 closes the leave dialog and keeps the user in the chat at the same stage; whatever was generating keeps going (Figma note: 「Stay → 關閉 dialog，留在原畫面」).
